newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Technihire slumps on possible loss warning.
newsitem.headline: Technihire slumps on possible loss warning.

text.p: Shares in South African personnel services firm, Technihire Ltd, slumped almost nine percent on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Wednesday following a warning on possible losses, dealers said.
"Yes, its down after this morning's announcement," a trader said.
By 0825 GMT the thinly-traded share was down seven cents to 71 cents in volume of 21,300 shares.

Technihire warned earlier that it had significant debtors who may not be in a position to repay monies due to the firm in full or within a reasonable period of time which could lead to losses in the company.
However, it said that its holding company, ADECCO, would ensure that sufficient working capital would at all times be made available for the firm to continue its normal operations.
Technihire incorporates a number of divisions which hire out staff in a wide range of fields of expertise, including accounting and drafting.
